instagram.text:
«النظافة من الإيمان»… حديث؟ 🤍
"Cleanliness is part of faith." Is it a hadith?

Scholars say it isn't authentic as a hadith, though its meaning is sound. And the authentic hadith says even more: "Purity is half of faith."

Before you forward a "hadith", check it. Send this to the family group chat 🤍
Which "hadith" should we check next? Tell us in the comments.
Follow @taqwalantern for daily reminders.

Authentic: Sahih Muslim 223 (excerpt, Abu Malik al-Ash'ari) · Sahih Muslim, Introduction (Samurah ibn Jundab and al-Mughirah ibn Shu'bah). Gradings: Ibn Baz and Ibn 'Uthaymin via dorar.net. Translations: HadeethEnc.com.

#hadith #checkbeforeyoushare #islamicreminders #islam #حديث

metadata.altText: Cover: check before you share. The saying النظافة من الإيمان, "Cleanliness is part of faith." A hadith? Two buttons, yes and no. Answer in the comments, then swipe.

The saying struck through, with a red stamp: not authentic as a hadith. Ibn Baz: attributing it to the Prophet is not correct. Ibn 'Uthaymin: it is not a hadith, but its meaning is sound. Good meaning, just don't say "the Prophet said."
A gold seal, authentic: the authentic one says even more. Purity is half of faith. Sahih Muslim 223, excerpt.
Why we check, a hadith in Arabic with English: Whoever reports a Hadith on my authority that is thought to be false is one of the two liars. Sahih Muslim, Introduction.
Closing card with a gold lantern: send this to the family group chat; which "hadith" should we check next? Comment it. Follow @taqwalantern for daily reminders.
